source.target: current authenticated active-tenant System Health workspace
source.verification: read-only navigation is exposed only for a server-authoritative user/active tenant with tenant.view and diagnostics.view and the server independently re-authorizes the destination

laravel_adaptation.details: Services and database status / فحص الخدمات وقاعدة البيانات
laravel_adaptation.availability_contract: render only when the user id is valid, active tenant is present in server-provided memberships, both permissions or wildcard are present, and the registered workspace route remains /system-health with diagnostics.view permission
laravel_adaptation.tenant_derivation: FrontendContext.tenant.slug through tenantUrl; API/action/query/direct-ID values cannot replace the active tenant

runtime_path: authenticated tenant bootstrap returns server-derived FrontendContext user, active tenant, memberships and permissions
CurrentUserSiteDetailsControl composes CurrentUserSystemHealthControl without replacing newer CurrentUser controls
the control fail-closes unless the active tenant is in server-provided memberships, user identity is valid, both required permissions are authoritative and the route contract is exact
the link target is derived only from context.tenant.slug and URL-encoded by tenantUrl
the explicit SystemHealthRouteServiceProvider GET route re-applies web session, auth and tenant.context
CanonicalWorkspaceRouteController re-applies tenant.view and diagnostics.view through TenantAuthorizer before returning the real workspace

authorization.active_tenant_resolution: tenant.context plus server-provided FrontendContext membership check
authorization.cross_tenant_destination_synthesis: tenant slug is URL-encoded and derived only from authoritative frontend context

validation_and_fail_closed.client_identity_validation: positive safe-integer user id and active tenant membership required
validation_and_fail_closed.route_contract_validation: system-health path and diagnostics.view permission must match exactly
validation_and_fail_closed.foreign_path_validation: encoded tenant slug cannot be interpreted as /tenants/beta
validation_and_fail_closed.direct_id_validation: not applicable; operation exposes no object identifier
validation_and_fail_closed.truthful_failure: missing auth/tenant/permission/route contract produces no control or server redirect/403/404 rather than sample success

read_only_and_safety.csrf: not applicable: route methods are GET/HEAD only and the control emits no form, fetch, apiRequest or mutation action
read_only_and_safety.authoritative_persistence_reread: not applicable: selected operation is navigation-only and persists no state
read_only_and_safety.idempotency: repeated authorized GETs render the same guarded workspace without creating tenant membership or role state
read_only_and_safety.retry: safe as read-only GET; no job or external side effect is scheduled
read_only_and_safety.cancellation: not applicable: no asynchronous or mutating operation exists
read_only_and_safety.secret_read_or_write: none; sentinel secret is asserted absent from rendered response
read_only_and_safety.fake_or_demo_success: none; control contains no sample/demo/fake success path
read_only_and_safety.success_semantics: the client only exposes a navigation link after authoritative context checks; the server independently authorizes the real destination

acceptance_tests: current-user-system-health-control.test.tsx exact tenant target, URL encoding, dual permission fail-closed, wildcard RBAC, authoritative membership/user identity and mutation-authority rejection
validation_state: source implementation head entered exact-head PR validation with Plan Link and Cross-Domain Security green and focused/full SQLite/frontend suites green; final evidence-bearing exact-head gates and generator reconciliation remain required before integration
scope_exclusions: no change to the ASP.NET/reference product
no claim that a separate canonical route operation is terminal
no mutation, provider API, connector, WordPress, AI, queue, scheduler, cache or secret behavior
no manual edit of generated reconciliation counts
